integrity: The complete proof and an independent standard-library diagnostic checker are provided. Numerical checks corroborate but do not replace analytic arguments.
scientific_limitations: Perfect renewal of heading to angle zero, independent angular Brownian cycles, independent isotropic positional Brownian noise, strictly positive iid inter-reset intervals with finite third moment. The unbounded longitudinal bound holds across laws with nonuniform moments, not for one fixed law. Literature overlap is best-knowledge, not publication-priority certification.
title: Fixed-mean orientational resetting: sharp transverse diffusion and longitudinal anisotropy reversal
